title.zh: Perplexity开源27B决策模型，官方评测综合分略超Jev
title.en: Perplexity开源27B决策模型，官方评测综合分略超Jev

current_state.zh: Perplexity launched a Decisions API and open-sourced its 27B multimodal decision model pplx-decider-v1-27b, which returns probability distributions over predefined answers for classification, routing and agent action selection, claiming an 85.71% average across 11 self-run benchmarks that slightly beats Jev.
